completion.text: {"insufficient_evidence": false, "answer": "The pilot touched down hard and bounced after landing in shifting winds, then tried to ease back pressure on the yoke, but the nose lowered and the nose wheel struck the ground, substantially damaging the forward fuselage and firewall [20221013106119:report_pdf]. The NTSB determined the probable cause was the pilot's improper landing flare and remedial action, which resulted in a hard, bounced landing [20221013106119:probable_cause][20221013106119:report_pdf]. The pilot said the accident could have been avoided by applying full power and performing a go-around after the first touchdown [20221013106119:report_pdf]."}
